claims.claim_text: PowerCo SE (wholly owned by Volkswagen) has agreed to contribute up to $130.7M over two years for the Project, with the goal of industrializing QS technology based on QSE-5. The PowerCo Collaboration Agreement was signed July 2024 and amended/restated July 2025; a $130M initial royalty fee is contemplated upon entry into the PowerCo IP License Agreement.
claims.subject: QuantumScape
claims.predicate: has signed an industrialization/licensing collaboration with
claims.object_value: PowerCo SE (Volkswagen subsidiary); up to $130.7M project funding; $130M initial royalty fee upon IP License signature
claims.source_quote: In July 2025, we entered into an amendment and restatement of the Collaboration Agreement ... PowerCo has agreed to contribute up to $130.7 million for the Project over the next two years, subject to the completion of certain milestones

claims.claim_text: QSE-5 B-samples have an energy density of over 800 Wh/L and 15-minute 10% to 80% fast-charging capability. B1 samples were demonstrated in a Ducati V21L electric motorcycle at IAA Mobility 2025. Glossary defines QSE-5 as a ~5 Ah solid-state lithium-metal cell.
claims.subject: QSE-5 cell
claims.object_value: >800 Wh/L energy density; 15-min 10-80% fast-charge; B1 sample in Ducati V21L demo at IAA 2025
claims.source_quote: These are B-samples of our first product, QSE-5, with an energy density of over 800 Wh/L and 15 minute 10% to 80% fast-charging capability. In 2025, together with Volkswagen and PowerCo, we had the first live demonstration of our solid-state lithium-metal battery technology powering a Ducati V21L electric motorcycle at the IAA Mobility event that included B1 samples of our QSE-5 cell
claims.source_quote_extra: Energy density specification stated WITHOUT explicit C-rate, temperature, or depth-of-discharge test conditions in this section of the disclosure.

claims.claim_text: QuantumScape is a development-stage / pre-revenue company that has incurred an operating loss of approximately $472.6M for FY2025, a net loss of $435.1M, an accumulated deficit of approximately $3.8B from inception, and continues to fund operations principally via ATM equity offerings ($264.2M in FY2025; $128.5M in FY2024).
claims.subject: QuantumScape
claims.object_value: pre-revenue; FY2025 net loss $435.1M; operating loss $472.6M; accumulated deficit $3.8B; ATM raises $264.2M FY25, $128.5M FY24; cash $970.8M
claims.source_quote: We are a development-stage company with no revenue to date, have incurred a net loss from operations of approximately $472.6 million for the year ended December 31, 2025, and an accumulated deficit of approximately $3.8 billion ... we sold 29.5 million shares of our Class A Common Stock pursuant to the ATM offering and received approximately $264.2 million

claims.claim_text: QuantumScape's Class A Common Stock was delisted from NYSE effective December 22, 2025 and began trading on Nasdaq under symbol QS on December 23, 2025 (listing transfer, not delisting for non-compliance per the filing's text).
claims.subject: QuantumScape Class A Common Stock
claims.source_quote: Effective December 23, 2025, our Class A Common Stock was listed and began trading on Nasdaq under the symbol QS. From November 27, 2020 through December 22, 2025, our Class A Common Stock was listed on the NYSE

claims.claim_text: QS pilot manufacturing line for solid-state cells is located in San Jose, California (Company HQ). This is the pilot line on which the PowerCo joint scale-up team operates and from which initial QSE-5 production is targeted.
claims.subject: QuantumScape pilot line
claims.object_value: San Jose, California (US R&D / cell-build pilot facility handling battery hazmat)
claims.source_quote: We are headquartered in San Jose, California. Our facilities, which are primarily in San Jose, California include certain leased properties for our offices and engineering, research and development, and cell build pilot line.

claims.claim_text: The $19.5M received from PowerCo in 2025 (as part of the up-to-$130.7M Project funding) was recorded as a capital contribution to Additional Paid-In Capital, not as revenue, under ASC 730-20 due to the presumed repayment obligation arising from the significant related-party relationship between QS and Volkswagen/PowerCo.
claims.subject: PowerCo Project payment ($19.5M FY25)
claims.object_value: Capital contribution to APIC, not revenue (ASC 730-20 related-party R&D arrangement)
claims.source_quote: During the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company received $19.5 million from PowerCo and such amount was recorded as a capital contribution to Additional Paid-In Capital in the Consolidated Statement of Shareholders Equity upon legal extinguishment. No shares were issued related to this capital transaction.
